question: 'Ama Odisha Nabin Odisha' scheme was implemented by which department in July 2023 by the Odisha Government?

options.text: Panchayati Raj and Drinking Water Department

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Panchayati Raj and Drinking Water Department**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'Ama Odisha Nabin Odisha'** scheme was launched to ensure **sustainable development** in rural areas.
 
• This scheme emphasizes the **empowerment of Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)** to enhance local governance.
 
• The scheme aims at improving **drinking water facilities** and **sanitation** in rural areas of Odisha.
 
• It focuses on **community participation** to ensure effective implementation and maintenance of water supply systems.
 
• The scheme was launched in **July 2023** by the Odisha Government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Health and Family Welfare Department**__

 __
 
• This department is responsible for **healthcare services** and **public health policies**.
 
• It aims to improve **health infrastructure** and ensure accessibility to healthcare for all citizens.
 
• Key programs include **immunization drives, maternal health initiatives**, and **infectious disease control**.
 
 
 
• **Housing and Urban Development Department**__
 __
 
• This department focuses on **urban planning** and **development**.
 
• It works on projects related to **housing, sanitation, and urban infrastructure**.
 
• Initiatives include **affordable housing schemes** and **slum redevelopment**.
 
 
 
• **General Administration Department**__
 
 
• This department handles **administrative functions** and **policy formulation** for the state government.
 
• It oversees the **implementation of government policies** and ensures **efficient governance**.
 
• Key responsibilities include **personnel management** and **coordination between various departments**.
